issues.on_page: Other financing sources (uses): Interest paid on long-term debt (5,113), Principal paid on long-term debt (32,316); Total other financing sources (uses) 44,606 (p6 Total col.; Landfill col. (37,429) p5; Sch 2 p12)
issues.issue: The report prints these two Landfill Fund payments in the Other financing sources (uses) section, not among expenditures. Under the user's printed-section rulings (2026-10-29 'as printed'; 2026-11-06 bond/loan proceeds follow the printed section), they belong in other_financing = -37,429 (computed: -5,113 - 32,316, p6), with detail[40]/[41] in section 'other financing' at -5,113 / -32,316. The governmental disbursements would then sum to the printed total 5,468,312. The roll-forward ties either way: 8,169,032 + 6,365,205 - 5,468,312 + 1,685,963 - 1,603,928 + 0 - 37,429 = 9,110,531 (p6). The current entry sums disbursements to 5,505,741 and also reaches 9,110,531. It follows the extractor's own outside_printed_total rule ('loan payments under Other Receipts (Disbursements)'). The budgetary Schedule 22 (p31) also counts them as Sanitation Landfill disbursements: 918,288 = 880,859 + 37,429. The rules conflict, so this is a warning and not an error. Recommend other_financing to follow the printed section. A person needs to settle the conflict, and decision_needed[] does not raise it.
